name: portfolio-game-maintainer
title_zh: React+Phaser 双形态作品集的专属维护器
tagline_zh: 双语 React 经典页与 Phaser 冒险页、共享内容、任务、素材、无障碍、PWA 行为，一次审计全查。
tagline_en: Audits bilingual React classic view, Phaser adventure, shared content, quests, assets, a11y, PWA—all in one repo.
desc_en: Design, implement, or audit the bilingual React classic portfolio, Phaser adventure, shared content, quests, assets, accessibility, and PWA behavior in portfolio-game. Do not use for generic TypeScript work unrelated to this product.
why_zh: 它把双形态作品集拆成可验证的模块网格，改一处能提示牵动的共享层。
why_en: Splits the dual-mode portfolio into a checkable module grid; flags shared-layer ripple effects and audits PWA/a11y/quest chains.
limit_zh: 只认 Xyphes/portfolio-game 这一个仓库的目录结构和约定；换仓库、换框架。
limit_en: Only works on Xyphes/portfolio-game's structure & conventions; other repos, frameworks, or plain TS get no answer. Outputs audit + suggestions, no.
title_en: Dedicated maintainer for React+Phaser dual-mode portfolio
